positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "I am prayerfully optimistic that the SCOTUS decision to overturn Roe v. Wade will hold until the opinion is published later on. but the left’s leak of a draft opinion in order to intimidate justices to change their opinion is a disgrace. We must be a nation that protects life."

"In the 48 years since Roe v. Wade, more than 62 million children have been deprived of their most basic right: life. Today we remember them, and we unite to end abortion and build a culture of life."
Rated 100% by National Right to Life Committee
Rated 92% by Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America

evidence.text: "Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth? No"

"Government spending is out of control, and our national debt is growing by the trillions. This is one of the greatest national security threats we currently face.
